$comment: SOURCE, NOT GENERATED. Every icon renamed after it shipped: the old name, the new one, and the version the new name ships in. Keyline kept each rename from 1.0.0 on as a deprecated alias. @quick-ui/icons doesn't (decided 2026-11-25, docs/plans/icons-package.md): it has no users who imported the old names, so scripts/generate.mjs exports current names only. An old name drawn again as a new icon is `reclaimed` in the version that draws it (`flower`, in 2.8.0): from then on it is that drawing and keeps no alias. The old name also belongs under the new one in the `names` map of data/icon-aliases.json.
